svg.text: side against the tray wall) and at the top (the tray top closes it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm flange on the back edge of each side, folded outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill three 4.1 holes in each flange, 5 from the side wall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flanges flat on the inside of the back wall, bottom 281.5

svg.text: up from the connector face, centred across. Six countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blind rivets from outside. It is the latch doubler: the pawl's

svg.text: lifting load goes into its bottom, then through the rivets.
